title: 开启“203时代”丨2026中国银行北京马拉松暨全国马拉松锦标赛圆满落幕
claims: The 2026 Beijing Marathon started at 07:30 on 18 October 2026 from Tiananmen Square with 32,000 runners over a 42.195 km course.
The event was the Beijing Marathon and the National Marathon Championships combined, with more than 140 professional athletes starting on the same gun and the same course as the mass field.
The National Marathon Championships entry lists contained 104 men and 44 women.
Tamirat Tola of Ethiopia won in 2:03:10, taking almost four minutes off the previous course record of 2:07:06 and setting a new best mark for a marathon run in mainland China.
Muktar Edris finished second in 2:04:34 and Adane Kebede Gebre third in 2:05:10.
Anchinalu Dessie Genaneh won the women's race in 2:20:36; Chinese runner Cirencuomu was second in 2:23:48 and Lu Ying third in 2:24:24.
Li Dalin ran 2:08:30 as the fastest Chinese man, fourth overall.
The race day was clear after heavy rain the previous day, with visibility above 10 km, temperatures of 14–19 C and a northerly wind around force 3.
Eight refreshment stations, seven drinking/water stations and seven food supply stations were set out along the course.

Medical cover comprised 26 fixed medical points, 35 ambulances, 100 AED units, 610 medical observers and 160 first-aid runners at a ratio of 1:200, plus a 200 square metre medical service centre at the finish.
Toilet places were increased to 1,199 at the start, 240 along the course and 191 at the finish.
The reusable cup, multi-tap self-service water drums and backpack water units were introduced in 2026.
A 10 km companion event was held on 11 October 2026 in Longtan Zhonghu Park with 1,780 runners.
The race expo ran from 15 to 17 October 2026 at the China International Exhibition Center, Chaoyang hall.
